summary:
Project details
My project is about identifying places on Earth that are similar to the Moon and Mars. These places are called Earth analog locations. For example, the Atacama Desert in Chile, Antarctica, and Mauna Kea in Hawaii have environments similar to the Moon and Mars. Scientists study these places to understand the soil, rocks, temperature, and climate. This research helps them test space equipment and prepare astronauts for future missions. It also helps scientists plan permanent human bases on the Moon and explore Mars.
